agent_id.description: Agent whose memory store to materialize. Missing agent_id skips memory.

conversation_id.description: Agent Builder conversation id for telemetry correlation.

prompt.description: The user message for this round, used as a memory search query when present.

sandbox_id.description: Workspace key from nightshift.obtainSandbox. Already space-scoped.

failed.description: The write failed; its contents may be incomplete.

notification.description: Markdown fragment listing memory pages new this turn, empty when there were none. On failure, the incomplete-materialization notice for /workspace/memories.

recalled_ids.description: Memory page ids recalled for this exact conversation round.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox that received the memory pages.
